label: Bible Study
prompt: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, _____ me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
verse: And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom.
note: The thief's request on the cross — and Jesus' answer comes in the very next verse.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD _____.
verse: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.
note: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice — sung the day the ark came to Jerusalem.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the _____ ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
verse: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
note: Hezekiah's sign of healing: the shadow went backward ten degrees on the dial of Ahaz.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an _____? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
verse: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
note: God asks Job if he can land leviathan on a fishing line — creation contains things only its Maker can handle.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And God sent me before you to preserve you a _____ in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verse: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
note: Joseph to the brothers who sold him: God sent me ahead 'to preserve you a posterity' — providence reframing betrayal.
